name: hook-stage-adoption
goal: A hook stage added to the shared hooks directory acts only in a worktree that opted into that stage: a sibling that opted into pre-push under an earlier Harness is never handed commit-msg

evidence: Regression, found by Codex on the real repository: after harness hooks install in this worktree wrote the shared commit-msg wrapper (sha256 f7c9d906...), the sibling worktree harness-main-release-20261011 at b4afb74, which had opted into pre-push only, could not use the stage: sh .git/hooks/commit-msg /tmp/harness-legacy-hook-short-message.txt started there returned 1 with 'Unsupported hook stage commit-msg; only pre-push is offered'. Prior working behaviour: up to b4afb74 the shared hooks directory held the pre-push wrapper only (sha256 ce52024a...), and a commit in any worktree started no Harness. Root cause: hookScript('commit-msg') in src/utils/hookScript.ts tests and reads the same file, harness-hooks in the worktree's own Git directory, that every install since b4afb74 writes as the opt-in for pushes. The hooks directory is shared, so the new wrapper took an opt-in given for one stage as an opt-in for another and started '<that worktree's command> hooks run commit-msg', which an earlier command line refuses. HookInstallService wrote one file for all stages and its uninstall counted that one file for every stage. Not at fault: the pre-push wrapper (byte-identical to b4afb74), the commit message rule, and the sibling, which is not to be edited.

Test files, written before any product change (sha256 in work/hook-stage-adoption/red-test-hashes.txt; product identical to 6f1e9ff, hashes in product-before.sha256): test/hooks-shared-stages.e2e.test.ts with test/support/sharedHooks.ts and legacyHooks.ts, test/services/hook-install.test.ts, test/utils/hook-script.test.ts. The fixture is a real temporary repository with a bare remote, hooks the project already had for both stages, an unrelated pre-commit hook and file, and three worktrees on its one hooks directory: legacy, opted in as b4afb74 did (its pre-push wrapper, verbatim and equal by sha256 to the real installed one, and harness-hooks naming a command line that records how it is started and refuses every stage but pre-push with b4afb74's words); current, opted in through the real CLI behind a recorder; plain, never opted in. Command: bun x vitest run test/utils/hook-script.test.ts test/services/hook-install.test.ts test/hooks-shared-stages.e2e.test.ts. Result: exit 1, 9 failed and 2 passed (work/hook-stage-adoption/RED.log). The faithful failure: 'a worktree that opted into pushes under an earlier Harness is not handed commit-msg' received [1, 'Error: Unsupported hook stage "commit-msg"; only pre-push is offered.'] where [0, ''] is required, from sh <hooks>/commit-msg <message file> started in the legacy worktree with no commit made, which is the reviewer's check. The others fail on the missing contract: no opt-in file per stage, no enabled per stage in the status, stageFile not exported.

Repair at the root, inside the existing hookScript and HookInstallService contract: each stage has an opt-in file of its own in the worktree's own Git directory, holding the command of the Harness that asked for it. stageFile('pre-push') stays harness-hooks, the single command file every earlier version wrote, so the push wrapper and an earlier opt-in are unchanged byte for byte; a later stage reads harness-hooks-<stage> and never harness-hooks. install writes every stage file and rewrites every wrapper, which replaces the first commit-msg wrapper; uninstall removes its own files and takes a wrapper away, restoring the hook that was there, only when no worktree holds that stage's file; status reports enabled for each stage. A worktree that has only harness-hooks, from b4afb74 or from the first release with commit-msg, is in the push stage alone until harness hooks install is run there again, and hooks status says so. Guard, in normal verification: test/utils/hook-script.test.ts over every entry of hookStages (a later stage never reads the push opt-in, no two stages share a file, the push wrapper equals the earlier one) and test/services/hook-install.test.ts in test:unit; test/hooks-shared-stages.e2e.test.ts added to the test:e2e list of the root package.json, which bun run check and harness verify run. Rule strengthened where the hook invariant already is: the hooks guide, the acceptance criteria of the two feature specifications and AGENTS.md. No new workflow or command.

src/utils/hookScript.ts: new stageFile(stage) names the opt-in file of a stage, harness-hooks for pre-push and harness-hooks-<stage> for a later one; hookScript tests and reads that file. The pre-push wrapper is unchanged (sha256 ce52024a..., equal to b4afb74 and to the installed hook); the commit-msg wrapper is now sha256 9692ab60... and no longer names harness-hooks. src/services/HookInstallService.ts: install writes the command into each stage file and rewrites each wrapper; uninstall removes this worktree's files and, stage by stage, takes the wrapper away and restores the earlier hook only when no worktree holds that stage's file; status adds enabled to each entry of stages and keeps installed, enabled, stage and chained for pre-push. src/workflows/runHooks.ts: hooks status says whether commit-msg is enabled here and to run harness hooks install to adopt it. Rule strengthened, no new workflow: hooks guide (src/guides/history.ts), acceptance criteria and the shared-stage invariant in specification/features/planned/commit-message-limits.md and agentic-self-hosting.md, AGENTS.md, .codex/skills/harness/SKILL.md, README.md. Guard in normal verification: test/hooks-shared-stages.e2e.test.ts added to the test:e2e list of package.json; test/services/hook-install.test.ts and test/utils/hook-script.test.ts run in test:unit. Existing test/hooks-commit-msg.e2e.test.ts gained enabled: true in its exact stages expectation, the one contract change. tsc, eslint and harness audit pass; files under the limits (hookScript 72 lines, HookInstallService 140). Manifests function.hook-script and service.hook-install re-derived in a throwaway copy; harness units index (dry run) lists nothing; 9 reasons recorded through harness explain add, none missing.

Same five test files as the red run, byte for byte (shasum -a 256 -c work/hook-stage-adoption/red-test-hashes.txt: 5 OK). Command: bun x vitest run test/utils/hook-script.test.ts test/services/hook-install.test.ts test/hooks-shared-stages.e2e.test.ts. Result: exit 0, 3 files and 11 tests passed (work/hook-stage-adoption/GREEN.log). In the temporary repository: the shared commit-msg hook started in the legacy worktree on a message file returns 0 with no output; its long, unprefixed commit is made; its push starts its own command line exactly once with 'hooks run pre-push' and nothing else is ever started there; the worktree that never opted in commits and pushes with neither command line started; the current worktree is refused the same message before the commit exists and makes a short one, its command line started twice with 'hooks run commit-msg'; the project's own hooks ran first all eight times. Status: legacy pre-push enabled and commit-msg not, plain neither, current both; the legacy opt-in file and the push wrapper are byte for byte what the earlier install wrote. Uninstall in the current worktree returns the hooks directory to the snapshot taken after the earlier install; uninstall of the last opt-in returns it, modes and bytes of every file including the unrelated hook and file, and .git/config to the snapshot taken before any Harness. Installing over the first commit-msg wrapper (sha256 f7c9d906...) replaces it. Real command lines, work/hook-stage-adoption/real-legacy-proof.sh and .log: b4afb74 exported from Git installs its push hook in one worktree; HEAD 6f1e9ff before the repair then makes the reviewer's check fail there with exit 1 and 'Unsupported hook stage "commit-msg"; only pre-push is offered.'; the repaired command line makes it exit 0, the legacy and plain worktrees commit freely, the current one is refused, b4afb74's own status and uninstall still work and leave no file behind. Targeted freeze set: 13 files, 54 tests passed (FREEZE.log): hook-script, hook-install, shared stages, hooks-commit-msg, hooks, commit-message unit and service, guides, regression-loops, format-ignore, files, project-template, loop.

work/hook-stage-adoption/guard-proof.sh, in a throwaway copy of the checkout under /tmp with only src/utils/hookScript.ts changed. Reintroduction 1, one opt-in file for every stage as before the repair (stageFile returns harness-hooks): bun x vitest run of the three guard files exits 1, 6 failed and 5 passed (guard-REINTRODUCED-one-file.log); the e2e guard fails with the original 'Unsupported hook stage "commit-msg"; only pre-push is offered.', and the unit invariant, two service tests and the other two e2e tests fail. Reintroduction 2, only the wrapper reads the push opt-in while install still writes a file per stage: exit 1, 4 failed and 7 passed (guard-REINTRODUCED-wrapper-only.log): the two unit invariants and the two e2e tests that commit in the legacy worktree, again with the original message. Restored to the repaired file, identical to the checkout by diff: exit 0, 11 passed (guard-RESTORED.log). The copy is removed; the checkout was not written by the script.
Full root, Rust, Wasm and installer checks passed; focused browser, state-scope and real legacy-hook guards passed. Source-bound proof follows.
